name: Volcanic & aviation ash
value: No red aviation codes on major routes
summary: No eruptions disrupting major air routes
state: No volcano is at aviation colour code red near major air routes and no large explosive eruption was reported in late October (Volcano Discovery, 20 Oct). Kīlauea in Hawaiʻi continues episodic lava fountaining, which does not affect international aviation.
for_you: No volcanic disruption to flights at present.
rubric_hit: No aviation colour code red; no large eruptions.
